task: Escribe 6 a 8 frases sobre un viaje que hiciste: adónde fuiste, cómo viajaste, qué hiciste y qué te gustó más (usa el pasado simple).
paragraphs: Last month, my sister and I spent a weekend in Edinburgh, the capital of Scotland. We travelled there by train from London. The journey took four and a half hours, but it was very comfortable and we had beautiful views of the sea.

On Saturday morning, we visited Edinburgh Castle. It stands on a big rock in the middle of the city, so you can see it from almost everywhere. It was quite expensive, but the views from the top were amazing. In the afternoon, we walked down the Royal Mile, the oldest street in the city, and we bought some presents for our parents.
In the evening, we wanted to try haggis, a traditional Scottish dish. My sister loved it, but I didn't like it very much. After dinner we went to a pub and listened to live folk music.

On Sunday it rained all morning, so we went to the National Museum, which is free. Then, in the afternoon, the sun came out and we climbed Arthur's Seat, a hill near the city centre. It was hard work, but it was the best part of the trip.
We didn't have enough time to see everything. We want to go back next summer!
